source.title: Hinterlands Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 10 Wrath Whelps and 3 Wyrmkin Starhunters in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
